# The field's command menu and its help line
Take off and fly the map.
Save the game in a slot.
Set the cheats of this run.
This cannot be used or dropped here.
Bag full: nothing more can be taken.
column2: 袋子滿了，不能再拿東西。

column1: Usable: on the map and in battle
column2: 可在地圖上及戰鬥中使用

column1: A card as the game deals it

column2: A  保留   B  還原

column1: Reset all options to their defaults?
column2: 把所有選項重設為預設值嗎？

column1: None. The game plays as the original.
# The options, cheats and setup pages
Battles on the map. Story battles always happen.
column2: 地圖上的戰鬥。劇情戰鬥一定會發生。

column1: Damage you take is divided by this.
column2: 受到的傷害會除以這個數值。
每場戰鬥後得到的經驗值。

column1: Every card you draw carries a Z.
HP and BP of every enemy.
How many enemies come at once.
How often a random battle starts.
Keep zeni at the most you can carry.
Using an item does not use it up.
Large makes the text of the menus a quarter bigger where it has room.
column2: 「大」會在有空間時把選單文字放大四分之一。

column1: Safe is a bigger blue arrow with a bar under the row: it does not rely on orange against red.
column2: 「醒目」是較大的藍色箭頭，該行下方有橫線，不靠紅底上的橙色辨認。

column1: The story's text in Enhanced mode. Chinese needs zh-hk.tsv and a Noto Sans HK font in the data folder.
column2: 加強模式中故事的文字。中文需要 data 資料夾內的 zh-hk.tsv 及 Noto Sans HK 字型。

column1: White windows with black text and a black frame, instead of cream and orange.
column2: 白色視窗、黑色文字及黑框，取代米色及橙色。

column1: Mono plays the same sound from both sides, for one speaker or one ear.
column2: 單聲道會從兩邊播放相同的聲音，適合單一喇叭或單耳收聽。

column1: Volume of the game's sound, in steps of ten. Left and Right change it by one step.
column2: 遊戲聲音的音量，以十為一級。左及右每次調整一級。

column1: A light tick of the phone under the finger when a button is pressed.
column2: 按下按鈕時，手機會在手指下輕輕震動。

column1: Confirms in the menus and talks on the map. Press A, then the new key. Esc cancels.
column2: 在選單中確定，在地圖上對話。按A，然後按新的按鍵。Esc取消。

column1: Cycles the game speed. Works in every mode. Press A, then the new key. Esc cancels, Backspace clears.
column2: 切換遊戲速度，所有模式都適用。按A，然後按新的按鍵。Esc取消，Backspace清除。

column1: D-pad is the fixed cross at the left. Stick is a floating stick that appears under the thumb. Move and resize the buttons in the Edit layout of the touch MENU.
column2: 「十字鍵」是固定在左邊的十字。「搖桿」是在拇指下出現的浮動搖桿。可在觸控MENU的「編輯配置」中移動按鈕及調整大小。

column1: Each device has its own map. A gamepad is found by itself when it is plugged in.
column2: 每個裝置有各自的按鍵配置。手掣接上後會自動偵測。

column1: Goes back in the menus. Press A, then the new key. Esc cancels.
column2: 在選單中返回。按A，然後按新的按鍵。Esc取消。

column1: How see-through the touch buttons are, from 20% to 100%.
column2: 觸控按鈕的透明度，由20%至100%。

column1: Loads the state of the chosen slot. Esc cancels, Backspace clears.
column2: 讀取所選欄位的即時記錄。Esc取消，Backspace清除。

column1: On: in a battle only the d-pad and big A and B show, and the full layout comes back after it. Off: the MIN and FULL buttons switch by hand.
column2: 開啟：戰鬥中只顯示十字鍵及大的A和B，戰鬥後回復完整配置。關閉：用MIN及FULL按鈕手動切換。

column1: On: the touch buttons hide while a gamepad is connected.
column2: 開啟：接上手掣時隱藏觸控按鈕。

column1: Pauses the game. Press A, then the new key. Esc cancels, Backspace clears.
column2: 暫停遊戲。按A，然後按新的按鍵。Esc取消，Backspace清除。

column1: Press A, then the new key. Esc cancels. A key already used is refused.
column2: 按A，然後按新的按鍵。Esc取消。已使用的按鍵不能選。

column1: Puts every touch button back where the design has it, in both orientations. The other choices stay.
column2: 把所有觸控按鈕放回原本設計的位置（直向及橫向）。其他選擇不變。

column1: Saves the picture as a PNG in the Pictures folder. Esc cancels, Backspace clears.
column2: 把畫面以PNG存到「圖片」資料夾。Esc取消，Backspace清除。

column1: Writes the state of the chosen slot (Classic and Enhanced). Esc cancels, Backspace clears.
column2: 把即時記錄寫入所選欄位（經典及加強模式）。Esc取消，Backspace清除。

column1: Damage, defence, encounters, Z cards and more, step by step. A preset changed there reads Custom.
column2: 傷害、防禦、遇敵、Z卡等，逐項設定。在那裏改動後，預設會顯示「自訂」。

column1: Easy and Hard mark the save with the CHEATS badge. Only Normal is clean.
column2: 「容易」及「困難」會在記錄加上「秘技」標記。只有「普通」沒有標記。

column1: Sets enemy power, EXP and money together. Normal is the original game. Easy and Hard mark the save with the CHEATS badge.
column2: 同時設定敵人強度、經驗及金幣。「普通」即原版遊戲。「容易」及「困難」會在記錄加上「秘技」標記。

column1: The preset and the Cheats screen write the same numbers: the last change wins.
column2: 預設及秘技畫面寫入相同的數值，以最後的改動為準。

column1: Choose Classic or Enhanced. The game restarts into the choice; your saves stay.
column2: 選擇經典或加強模式。遊戲會以所選模式重新啟動，記錄會保留。

column1: Pick hd-pack.zip to install or update the art (about 0.9 GB). The game restarts into the install.
column2: 選擇hd-pack.zip以安裝或更新圖像（約0.9 GB）。遊戲會重新啟動並進行安裝。

column1: The art pack the Enhanced mode draws from.
column2: 加強模式使用的圖像資源包。

column1: The game restarts when a button here opens the setup.
column2: 按這裏的按鈕開啟設定時，遊戲會重新啟動。

column1: The mode the game starts in.
How fast a message is written, from Slowest to Fastest. The same setting as the Text entry of the Menu: change it in either place.
column2: 訊息顯示的速度，由「最慢」至「最快」。與選單中「文字」一項是同一設定，可在任何一處更改。

column1: How long a finished message stays up before A is pressed: a short, a normal or a long time.
column2: 訊息顯示完後，在按A之前停留的時間：短、普通或長。

column1: How often a random battle comes. The same value as the Cheats screen rows Random battles and How often.
column2: 隨機戰鬥出現的頻率。與秘技畫面中「隨機戰鬥」及「頻率」兩行是同一數值。

column1: Plays the battle animations faster. The turn order and the numbers do not change.
column2: 加快戰鬥動畫。行動次序及數值不變。

column1: When a message has been written and waits for A, the game presses A for you after the wait below.
column2: 訊息顯示完並等待按A時，遊戲會在下面的等待時間後代你按A。

column1: 16:9 shows the extra map at the sides. 4:3 is the original picture shape. The change asks for confirmation.
column2: 16:9會在兩旁顯示更多地圖。4:3是原本的畫面比例。更改時需要確認。

column1: A tube's look: a soft glow, a dark edge and a faint mask. Soft is light, Full is heavy.
column2: 映像管的效果：柔和光暈、暗邊及淡淡的遮罩。「柔和」較輕，「完整」較重。

column1: Changes ask for confirmation and revert after 10 s if you do not keep them.
column2: 更改時需要確認，如不保留會在10秒後還原。

column1: Crisp is pixel art made bigger with smoothed diagonals. Smooth is a soft bicubic filter.
column2: 「銳利」是放大的像素圖，斜線經平滑處理。「平滑」是柔和的雙三次濾鏡。

column1: Dark lines between the lines of the original picture, as on a television.
column2: 在原本畫面的每行之間加上暗線，像電視一樣。

column1: How many times the PPU picture is redrawn in HD (2 to 8). Higher looks finer and costs more. The change asks for confirmation.
column2: PPU畫面以HD重繪的倍數（2至8）。越高越精細，但較耗效能。更改時需要確認。

column1: The size of the picture the game draws at this scale and aspect.
column2: 遊戲在此倍數及比例下繪製的畫面大小。

column1: Waits for the screen's refresh before showing a frame: no tearing, a little more delay.
column2: 顯示畫格前先等待螢幕更新：沒有畫面撕裂，但延遲稍多。

column1: Window or fullscreen on the desktop. The change asks for confirmation.
column2: 在桌面上以視窗或全螢幕顯示。更改時需要確認。

column1: This game needs your own copy of Super Saiya Densetsu. The file stays on this device and is never uploaded.
column2: 本遊戲需要你自己的《超撒亞傳說》。檔案只會留在這部裝置上，不會上載。
開啟系統的檔案選擇器。
日文版 Rev 1 + 修正檔

column1: This is the Japanese Rev 1 ROM. It needs the English v1.02 patch, the file dbz102.ips. Pick it to go on.
column2: 這是日文版 Rev 1 ROM，需要英文版 v1.02 修正檔 dbz102.ips。請選擇它以繼續。

column1: It is applied once; the patched ROM is kept.
column2: 修正只進行一次，修正後的ROM會保留。

column1: Enhanced mode uses the HD art pack. Pick the file hd-pack.zip. It takes about {} of free space once installed.
column2: 加強模式使用HD圖像資源包。請選擇檔案hd-pack.zip。安裝後約佔 {} 空間。

column1: Pick the file to install the pack.
column2: 選擇檔案以安裝資源包。

column1: Keep the app open while it installs. You can install the pack later from Options.
column2: 安裝期間請勿關閉程式。你也可以之後在「選項」中安裝資源包。

column1: How do you want to play? Your saves stay either way.
column2: 你想怎樣玩？無論選哪一個，記錄都會保留。

column1: The original game and its menus,
as it was on the console.
HD menus, art and extra options.
Change it later: Options > Game in Enhanced, or hold Select and Start for 2 seconds in Classic.
column2: 之後可更改：加強模式中選「選項 > 遊戲」，經典模式中按住Select及Start 2秒。
